rules.opt_in_reason: Surface measurement of sentence and word length. It runs at 2.964 per thousand words in the controlled arm against 0.711 in human prose, but it was frozen hypothesis H2 and returned +0.32 points on the confirmation partition at p 0.747. Length is not wording.

rules.summary: Review this common-noun sequence; keep established technical terms.
rules.description: Counts NN modifiers followed by an NN/NNS head within a shallow NP chunk, stopping at terms, identifiers, and configured verb forms in predicate position.
rules.limitations: Alpha defaults are editorial policy proposals; corpus precision has not been established. This surface measurement does not establish a grammatical error, a need for revision, or authorship. A shallow NP is not a dependency tree, and a noun sequence can be an appropriate domain term. Interior NNS tags cause abstention: they can be plural modifiers or misclassified finite verbs. The negative modal "cannot" breaks a noun run even when tagged NN; other tagging ambiguity remains possible. Configured verb forms are literal words; a form that is also a noun modifier shortens a genuine stack. Forms also listed in nouns remain candidates after nominal modifiers or common nouns; leading forms can break a run. Coordinated predicates require a following verb or modal; noun coordination stays intact.
rules.opt_in_reason: Version 4 did not establish a cross-family association in the complete-document study. Version 5 repairs noun/verb boundaries but has no independent editorial qualification.

rules.summary: Check whether repeated paired contrasts carry distinct information.
rules.description: Counts paired contrasts in bounded prose windows: 'rather than' and 'instead of' and comma-not alternatives within a sentence, and adjacent 'It is not about'/'It is about' sentence pairs including contractions.
rules.limitations: Alpha defaults are editorial policy proposals; corpus precision has not been established. Only the declared structures are recognized; no semantic equivalence is inferred. A single contrast is ordinary English and the window allows one; the rule measures repetition of the shape, not its use.

rules.summary: Review the load of balanced insertions; retain conditions, qualifications, and necessary definitions.
rules.description: Measures nonexempt words, pair count, and nesting of balanced parentheses and square brackets within a prose block.
rules.limitations: Alpha defaults are editorial policy proposals; corpus precision has not been established. This surface measurement does not establish a grammatical error, a need for revision, or authorship. Unbalanced or protected-crossing frames are not matched. Depth is capped at 256 with an explicit error. An insertion below min_insertion_words, such as an issue reference or a license label, contributes to none of the three measurements, including nesting.
rules.opt_in_reason: Fires more on human prose, 0.499 per thousand words against 0.300 in the controlled arm.

rules.summary: Several sentences contain be-plus-participle candidates; review voice only where the meaning allows it.

rules.limitations: Alpha defaults are editorial policy proposals; corpus precision has not been established. rules.opt_in_reason: Names candidates without a dependency parse, and says so in its own limitations. It runs at 1.953 per thousand words in the controlled arm against 1.112 in human prose.

rules.summary: Repeated denial and redefinition: review whether both clauses add information.

rules.summary: The contrast names abstract actions without their objects; name the check and its failure condition.

rules.summary: Reduce repeated whether-you prefaces while preserving alternatives.

rules.limitations: Alpha defaults are editorial policy proposals; corpus precision has not been established. Recognizes one opening template, not arbitrary conditional clauses.
rules.opt_in_reason: No occurrence in 5.6 million measured prose words, human or generated. It counts prefaces of the form "whether or not X".
